content.title: Arts and Culture Commission
content.summary: The Arvada Arts and Culture Commission (AACC) promotes arts, culture, and heritage in the community, supporting local artists and collaborating with various organizations. Meetings are held monthly on the third Thursday, and recruitment for board vacancies will begin in December. Interested individuals can find more information on the application process on the city's website.
content.body:
## Overview

The Arvada Arts and Culture Commission (AACC) supports, cultivates, and advocates for a variety of arts, culture, and heritage opportunities throughout our community. Other goals include

- Outreach and support of local artists
- Liaison and partnering with the Arvada Historical Society, the Arvada Festivals Commission, the Parks Advisory Committee, and other organizations
- Creation of a Cultural District

For more information on arts and culture opportunities in Arvada, [visit the Arts and Culture section of the City website](/488).

## Boards Details

- 9 members
- Terms vary in length
- Volunteer appointment
- One member may reside outside the city, all others must be Arvada residents
- Background checks are required for all board members

## Interested in Joining the Arvada Arts and Culture Commission?

Recruitment to fill vacancies on boards and commissions will begin in December. You can review the application process on the main [Boards, Commissions and Committees page](/248/Boards-Commissions-and-Committees).
